service.name: Americana band
service.serviceType: Americana and bluegrass band for corporate welcome receptions, retreats, picnics and weddings
service.description: An Americana band with voice, acoustic guitar, fiddle or mandolin, upright bass and drums, playing the Colorado songbook for conference welcome receptions, mountain retreats, incentive groups, summer company picnics and patio weddings across Denver and the Colorado mountains.

faqs.q: What does the Americana band play?
faqs.a: Two songbooks: the one people expect in the mountains, from the Grateful Dead to John Prine, and the one written in Colorado, from Nathaniel Rateliff to Gregory Alan Isakov, plus the bluegrass standards. It plays on acoustic guitar, fiddle or mandolin, upright bass and drums, and it's booked through Signet Artists in Denver.
It plays bluegrass when the night wants it, which is why the fiddle and mandolin are in the band, but the songbook is wider than that. Tell us the evening and we'll build the set to it.

The trio plays a reception or a dinner at a level people talk across, and on a lawn the people at the back hear the fiddle while the front tables keep talking. The quartet with drums is a dance band and plays up to whatever the venue allows. Mountain venues often have a sound limit or a curfew, so give us the number early and the set is built under it.

faqs.q: How much space and power does it need?
faqs.a: The trio sets up in about 12 by 8 feet on one dedicated 20-amp circuit and needs about an hour to set up. The quartet takes about 14 by 10 feet, two circuits and 90 minutes. Sound support that's the right size for the venue comes with both, and on a ranch or a resort deck that's what keeps acoustic instruments from disappearing.

faqs.q: Can it play outdoors and at altitude?
faqs.a: Yes, and lawns, ranches and resort decks are most of its work. It needs a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it, and we agree a plan for moving indoors with you ahead of time.

faqs.q: Can we add time or ask for a song?
faqs.a: Yes. If the evening runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night, and the band learns one song of your choosing as part of every booking.
